holder-quote: She rang a bell and one of the Flying Antinium instantly came out with a trolly of food. The Free Queen liked that and considered these helpers, if not as nice as Garry, good for letting him provide even more food to her. A net plus. She nodded at the Flying Antinium.
Niers blinked. Bird stared blankly at a tick trying to bite his arm. He was going to call this tick ‘Ineffectual Biter’. It would be his pet. He would become a [Pet Owner] and…
[Pet Owner]. It had surprised him that he could gain a class as a [Prisoner].
Calruz had gotten a rare Skill as a Level 11 [Pet Owner].
